input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: § 3.5 (Effect of Termination) addresses only Customer's payment obligations; searches for transition, return, export and deletion language return nothing, and § 14.18 (Data Protection) and § 11.6 (Content) impose no exit obligations on IBM. In a hosting agreement where Customer's Content resides in IBM's e-business Hosting Environment, the absence of any transition-assistance, data-return or deletion-certification obligation is a deviation. Inserted the playbook exit provision into § 3.5, which already survives termination under § 14.2.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and deletion certification obligations into § 3.5 (Effect of Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit provision to § 3.5 so that, on expiry or termination, IBM provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and then deletes it and certifies deletion; the Agreement is otherwise silent on getting our data back or migrating services. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of transition assistance with the same 30-day export and deletion certification.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall: (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available to Customer for export all Content and other Customer data in IBM's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
